environment.accelerator: CPU (XGBoost and scikit-learn do not use the Apple GPU/MPS here)

deployment_label: Trained on real Taiwanese card data (2005); not an Indian credit-bureau score

datasets.name: Default of Credit Card Clients
datasets.publisher: UCI Machine Learning Repository (I-Cheng Yeh, Che-hui Lien)
datasets.publication: Yeh & Lien (2009), Expert Systems with Applications 36(2) 2473-2480
datasets.population: Credit-card clients of a Taiwanese bank
datasets.format: Excel .xls (official); CSV copy used for training
datasets.verification: The local CSV is a cell-for-cell copy of the official UCI .xls: 30,000 x 25 values, 750,000 of 750,000 cells identical, 0 rows differing (checked 2026-11-15 with xlrd 2.0.2 in a scratch environment against 'default of credit card clients.xls', SHA-256 30c6be3abd8dcfd3e6096c828bad8c2f011238620f5369220bd60cfc82700933, from the official zip).

data_notes.duplicate_treatment: Kept: identical feature values for different customer IDs are plausible (distinct customers); they are counted and disclosed, not removed.
data_notes.negative_bill_treatment: Kept: a negative bill is a credit balance (overpayment). Utilisation uses max(0, bill).
data_notes.undocumented_code_treatment: No effect: SEX, EDUCATION and MARRIAGE are excluded from the model (fairness and portability), so their undocumented codes are not used.
data_notes.pay_status_codes: -2 no consumption, -1 paid in full, 0 revolving credit, 1..8 months of payment delay (codes -2 and 0 are not in the original paper's description; they are kept as observed).

datasets.preprocessing: Per customer: 14 behavioural features from 6 months of status, bills and payments (credit_risk.features_from_history): money as ratios to the credit limit, delay counts, utilisation and repayment ratios. SEX, EDUCATION and MARRIAGE excluded.
datasets.duplicates: 35 duplicate feature rows kept and disclosed
datasets.known_biases: Taiwan 2005, one bank, card customers only; 22% default rate; not representative of Indian borrowers.

methodology: XGBoost classifier (unchanged hyperparameters) + SHAP TreeExplainer; threshold maximising F1 on validation.
limitations: Learned on Taiwanese card customers in 2005. It estimates a default-risk pattern from payment behaviour; it is not an Indian credit-bureau score and its accuracy for Indian borrowers is not established.
reproducible: python -m app.ml.train credit_risk (seed 7) with the same CSV (SHA-256 above)
